subject: [PATCH v4 2/3] mm: swap: drop dropbehind swap cache folios on writeback completion

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's memory management to drop swap cache folios from their cache after writeback completion, rather than leaving them for reclaim later. This is done by extending the existing file dropbehind paths to swap cache folios and setting a flag to indicate that the write has completed. The patch also includes changes to various kernel files to support this new behavior. The goal of this change is to improve memory management efficiency by reducing unnecessary reclaim operations.
